title: The Normalized Maximum Likelihood for Regular Non-Smooth Models: Measure-Theoretic Foundations and Geometric Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2605.24477v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Normalized Maximum Likelihood (NML) codelength, or stochastic complexity, represents a principled criterion for universal coding. While recent coarea-based formulations provided a calculation method for smooth models, this framework collapses for the non-smooth estimators ubiquitous in modern machine learning (e.g., Lasso, Sparse SVMs). In this work, we provide a rigorous framework for computing the NML for regular path-differentiable Lipschitz (PDL) estimators. By applying classical geometric measure theory and bridging the coarea formula with conservative Jacobians, we prove that the stochastic complexity for non-smooth models is well-posed and theoretically consistent with the outputs of modern Automatic Differentiation. To compute this quantity exactly, we introduce the Propose-and-Project Metropolis-Hastings (PDL-PPMH) sampler, a geometric MCMC algorithm capable of traversing the non-differentiable level sets of the maximum

translated_title: 正则非光滑模型的归一化最大似然：测度论基础与几何采样
translated_abstract: 归一化最大似然（NML）编码长度，或称随机复杂度，是通用编码的一种有原则的准则。虽然近期基于余面积公式的公式化为光滑模型提供了计算方法，但该框架对于现代机器学习中普遍存在的非光滑估计器（如 Lasso、稀疏 SVM）会失效。在这项工作中，我们为计算正则的可微路径 Lipschitz（PDL）估计器的 NML 提供了一个严格的框架。通过应用经典几何测度论，并将余面积公式与保守雅可比矩阵相衔接，我们证明了非光滑模型的随机复杂度是适定的，且在理论上与现代自动微分的输出保持一致。为了精确计算这一量，我们提出了“提议-投影”Metropolis-Hastings（PDL-PPMH）采样器，这是一种几何 MCMC 算法，能够遍历最大似然估计不可微的水平集。
tldr: 本文为正则的非光滑估计器（如 Lasso、稀疏 SVM）建立了基于几何测度论与保守雅可比的 NML 随机复杂度严格计算框架，并提出了能够遍历不可微水平集的几何 MCMC 算法 PDL-PPMH。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a rigorous measure-theoretic framework for computing the NML stochastic complexity of regular non-smooth estimators (e.g., Lasso) by bridging the coarea formula with conservative Jacobians, and introduces PDL-PPMH, a geometric MCMC sampler capable of traversing non-differentiable level sets.
